findings.observed: The second put raises OverflowError after appending 'new'; len(q) is 2 and subsequent gets return both 'old' and 'new'.
findings.expected: The second put raises OverflowError without changing the queue; len(q) remains 1 and only 'old' can be retrieved.
findings.explanation: put mutates _items before checking capacity, so the operation reported as rejected still changes queued items.

findings.trigger: a = TaskQueue(2); b = TaskQueue(2); a.put('shared'); len(b); b.get()
findings.observed: len(b) is 1 and b.get() returns 'shared', even though the item was put only into a.
findings.expected: len(b) is 0 and b.get() raises IndexError because separate TaskQueue instances are independent.
findings.explanation: The mutable default items list is created once and reused by every instance constructed without an explicit items argument.
